sources.referenceDateNote: Title records have no common observation date. August 2026 is the database release month.

changes: Title pairs deduplicated by Unicode and punctuation normalization. Original display text retained, official titles preferred, all source categories retained as bit masks.
Short titles are included as alternate titles.
Wages retain separate published hourly and annual amounts. No wages are annualized or inferred.
OEWS detailed cross-industry, all-ownership rows only. Aggregate occupation and industry rows excluded.
O*NET specialties map to their published SOC code or its published SOC broad group. Other combinations remain explicitly unavailable.

valueSchema.at-or-above: Source marker and published lower bound retained
valueSchema.missing: Empty source cell or absent flat-file series, never zero

topCoding.note: Preserved only when the source marks a value. May 2025 can publish specific estimates above these limits.

titleSources.note: Bits combine when a pair occurs in several source lists.
